create_Settings_instance: create a Settings instance with key name, path, base port, repo details, instance type, and AWS regions
load_Settings_from_json: load a Settings object from a JSON configuration file using the Settings.load class method
validate_Settings_types: validate that all Settings input types are correct strings and base_port is an integer
handle_SettingsError: handle SettingsError exceptions raised when settings types are invalid or JSON is malformed
parse_aws_regions: parse AWS regions as a single string or list of strings into a normalized list
